## N’gathau Wizard 13/Inquisitor 5 (CR 20)

**XP** 307,200  
Male N’gathau (formerly human) wizard 13/inquisitor 5  
NE Medium outsider (augmented humanoid, n’gathau, evil, extraplanar)  
**Init** +7; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +23; **Aura** aura of madness (30 ft., 5 rounds/day, DC 14), horrifying appearance (DC 28)  


**Defense**


**AC** 29, touch 16, flat-footed 23 (+1 dodge, +7 armor, +4 deflection, +1 Dex, +6 natural)  
**hp** 329 (13d6+5d8+211)  
**Fort** +23; **Ref** +11; **Will** +19; +2 vs. creatures from Plane of Air, -2 vs. earth-based effects  
**Defensive Abilities** heavy fortification (75%); **DR** 10/magic; **Immune** acid, poison; **Resist** cold 5, fire 5; **SR** 31  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft.  
**Melee** 2 prosthetic claws +17 (1d6+7/19–20), or spiked armor +16/+11(1d6+7), or melee touch +16 (exquisite suffering)  
**Special Attacks** bane, cruelty’s bliss, delicious agony, exquisite suffering (DC 30), judgment 2/day  
**Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 5th)  

At will—detect alignment, discern lies (5 rounds/day)  
5/day—vision of madness  

**Inquisitor Spells Known** (CL 5th)  

2nd (3/day)—*[darkness](../../magic/spells/darkness.md)*, *[desecrate](../../magic/spells/desecrate.md)*, *[hold person](../../magic/spells/hold-person.md)* (DC 14)  
1st (5/day)—*[comprehend languages](../../magic/spells/comprehend-languages.md)*, *[curse water](../../magic/spells/curse-water.md)*, *[inflict light wounds](../../magic/spells/inflict-light-wounds.md)* (DC 13), *[tireless pursuit](../../magic/spells/tireless-pursuit.md)*  
0 (at-will)—*[bleed](../../magic/spells/bleed.md)* (DC 12), *[brand](../../magic/spells/brand.md)* (DC 12), *[daze](../../magic/spells/daze.md)* (DC 12), *[detect magic](../../magic/spells/detect-magic.md)*, *[light](../../magic/spells/light.md)*, *[read magic](../../magic/spells/read-magic.md)*  
**Domain** Madness  

**Wizard Spells Prepared** (CL 13th/5% chance of spell failure, melee touch +16, ranged touch +10)  

7th—*[plane shift](../../magic/spells/plane-shift.md)*  
6th—*[disintegrate](../../magic/spells/disintegrate.md)* (DC 22), empowered[ *enervation](../../magic/spells/enervation.md)*, *[globe of invulnerability](../../magic/spells/globe-of-invulnerability.md)*  
5th—*[blight](../../magic/spells/blight.md)* (DC 21), *[cone of cold](../../magic/spells/cone-of-cold.md)* (DC 21), empowered *[lightning bolt](../../magic/spells/lightning-bolt.md)* (DC 19), *[teleport](../../magic/spells/teleport.md)*  
4th—*[dimension door](../../magic/spells/dimension-door.md)*, *[ice storm](../../magic/spells/ice-storm.md)*, *[phantasmal killer](../../magic/spells/phantasmal-killer.md)* (DC 20), *[stoneskin* ](../../magic/spells/stoneskin.md)(2)  
3rd—empowered magic missile (2), *[fireball](../../magic/spells/fireball.md)* (DC 19), *[slow](../../magic/spells/slow.md)* (DC 19), *[vampiric touch](../../magic/spells/vampiric-touch.md)*  
2nd—*[arcane lock](../../magic/spells/arcane-lock.md)*, *[blur](../../magic/spells/blur.md)*, *[false life](../../magic/spells/false-life.md)*, *[flaming sphere](../../magic/spells/flaming-sphere.md)*, *[mirror image](../../magic/spells/mirror-image.md)*, *[protection from arrows](../../magic/spells/protection-from-arrows.md)*  
1st—*[charm person](../../magic/spells/charm-person.md)* (DC 17), *[magic missile](../../magic/spells/magic-missile.md)* (2), *[magic weapon](../../magic/spells/magic-weapon.md)*, *[protection from good](../../magic/spells/protection-from-good.md)*, *[shield](../../magic/spells/shield.md)*  
0 (at-will)—*[acid splash](../../magic/spells/acid-splash.md)*, *[flare](../../magic/spells/flare.md)* (DC 16), *[ghost sound](../../magic/spells/ghost-sound.md)* (DC 16), *[touch of fatigue](../../magic/spells/touch-of-fatigue.md)*  


**Statistics**


**Str** 25, **Dex** 13, **Con** 30, **Int** 23, **Wis** 15, **Cha** 19  
**Base Atk** +9; **CMB** +16; **CMD** 32  
**Feats** Brew Potion, Cleave, Combat Casting, [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md), Empower Spell, Eschew Materials, Improved Critical (prosthetic claw), Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, Martial Weapon Proficiency (spiked armor), Persuasive, Precise Strike, Scribe Scroll, Weapon Focus (prosthetic claw), [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), [Great Fortitude](../../rules/feats/great-fortitude.md), [Skill Focus (Intimidate)](../../rules/feats/skill-focus.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Diehard and Endurance and Toughness are one feat, Toughness; Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Dodgility, Great Fortitude, Skill Focus (Intimidate).*  
**Skills** Bluff +25, Craft (alchemy) +27, Diplomacy +29, Intimidate +45, Knowledge (arcana) +27, Knowledge (history) +27, Knowledge (planes) +27, Linguistics +11, Perception +23, Sense Motive +33, Spellcraft +27, Survival +2 (+4 tracking); **Racial Modifiers** +8 Intimidate, +8 Sense Motive  
**Languages** Abyssal, Aklo, Celestial, Common, Daemonic, Draconic, Giant, Infernal, Undercommon; speak with creatures from the Plane of Air  
**SQ** arcane bond (familiar—lost when became n’gathau), cunning initiative, limited immortality, monster lore +2, mutilations, stern gaze, solo tactics, track  
**Combat Gear** *ring of elemental command (air)*; **Other Gear** *+5 heavy fortification spiked leather bindings* (equal to leather armor, but only 5% spell failure), *ring of protection +4*, *boots of speed*, *gloves of arrow snaring* (fingerless), *bracelets of resistance +3* (set functions as cloak)  


**Special Abilities**


**N’gathau Mutilations** Neck has major flaying (+2 DC for horrifying appearance). Steel rods inserted into chin and braced on hips (+1 natural armor). Prosthetic claws affixed to tips of fingers (1d6 damage). The torso has been utterly mutilated with a hole opened through it through which his head protrudes (+2 DC for horrifying appearance, +1 natural armor). Spine dislocation/disjointed so that it folds under and protrude through his abdomen (–2 Strength, +2 Dexterity).  

**Horrifying Appearance (Su)** The sight of Aagash is so disturbing that any creature with fewer than 19 Hit Dice and Intelligence 3 or higher seeing him must make a successful Will save or be shaken for 1d6 rounds. Creatures with more than 19 HD are immune to this effect. On a successful save, the opponent is immune to the horrifying appearance of Aagash for one day.  

**Exquisite Suffering (Su)** As a melee touch attack, Aagash allows a creature to share in the sensations of his agony, thus overloading the senses of the opponent. The opponent must make a successful Will save (DC 30) or be stunned 1 for 1 round. Creatures with more than 19 HD are immune to this effect. This is a mind-affecting attack and whether the save is successful or not, the creature is immune to the exquisite suffering attack of Aagash for one day.  

**Cruelty’s Bliss (Su)** When Aagash scores a successful critical hit against an opponent (with a weapon attack or a natural attack), he gains a +2 competence bonus to attack rolls, checks, and saves against that opponent for the remainder of the encounter. This bonus can only be gained once per combat against a particular opponent.  

**Delicious Agony (Su)** By making a successful grapple check against an opponent up to Large size, Aagash can claw away a small portion of an opponent’s flesh and devour it. This attack deals 1d2 points of Constitution drain to the opponent. Aagash heals 5 points of damage each time he drains Constitution points (regardless of the number of points drained). A creature without flesh (such as an ooze, skeleton, etc.) is immune to this effect.  

**Limited Immortality (Ex)** When Aagash is slain his form is taken before the Twelve, who decide whether the slain creature is condemned to an eternity of torture and suffering or whether the creature is reconfigured. A reconfigured creature remembers nothing of his previous existence and for all intents and purposes is an entirely new creature. All existing mutilations are removed and new ones are added (determined randomly or by DM choice).
